name: DNF packages
description: Installs listed system packages from the repositories the image already configures.

packages.description: Comma-separated native package entries. Whitespace around entries and empty entries are ignored.

installWeakDeps.description: Include optional dependencies during native package resolution.

refreshPolicy.description: Select native default refresh, check every repository, or require cached metadata without refreshing.

cleanup.description: Remove all managed caches, package files only, or skip feature cleanup. Native retention remains independent.

networkTimeout.description: Native network timeout in seconds (1–3600), or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

best.description: Require the highest available version of each listed package, allow a lower one, or inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

enableRepositories.description: Comma-separated identifiers of repositories the image configures but leaves disabled, to enable, or empty to enable none; applies only to this invocation.

disableRepositories.description: Comma-separated identifiers of repositories the image enables, to leave out, or empty to leave none out; applies only to this invocation.

parallelDownloads.description: Upper bound of simultaneous downloads (1–20), or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.
